## Detailed Project Architectures

### 1. Real-Time AI Chat & Voice Assistant (SSE & RAG Pipeline)
- **Architecture**: NestJS backend orchestrating vector embeddings, context retrieval, and low-latency Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming connected to a Next.js / TanStack frontend.
- **Key Modules**:
  - Voice audio chunking and speech-to-text / text-to-speech synchronization.
  - Redis cache layer for conversational memory and token throttling.
  - Zero-latency token streaming with client-side optimistic reconciliation.

### 2. Interactive Portfolio v2
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16 App Router utilizing React Server Components (RSC), custom dynamic theme CSS variable generation, and PostgreSQL data persistence.
- **Key Modules**:
  - `proxy.ts`: Next.js 16 proxy pattern verifying JWT admin cookies and protecting backend mutations.
  - `services/`: Encapsulated data layer querying PostgreSQL through Prisma 7 with native pg pooling.
  - `components/seo/JsonLd.tsx`: Deep machine-readable JSON-LD entity graph for Google Knowledge Graph and AI search engines.

### 3. Cloud Infrastructure Observability
- **Problem**: High volume microservice metric telemetry was saturating relational databases and causing high latency in visual dashboards.
- **Solution**: Designed a high-throughput metric ingestion pipeline using Node.js streams, Redis Pub/Sub, and timeseries aggregations in PostgreSQL.
- **Impact**: Reduced query latency by 65% and successfully ingested over 1.2M metrics per minute without memory degradation.
